name: megane2-card-programming
label: Megane / Scenic II card programming
description: Enters after-sales mode, learns a card, then validates or abandons.
warning: Learns a new card into the UCH. Validating replaces the learned set — cards not present during the procedure stop working.
_unverified: Not run against a vehicle. Slug and request names are checked against the database; the effect is not.
_scope: Ports the documented badge-learning sequence only. The original also derives the after-sales PIN from the module's ISK via two bespoke routines; that derivation is not ported, and the operator supplies the code instead — which the original's UI also allows.
